title: spec/ui: a form-view predicate can read the organization's Localization locale, so an app can show one 姓名 input in a Chinese organization (replaces the personName proposal)
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Restart-grade: p2

> **Rewritten 2026-11-17** at the request of the person directing session_012dn2Acg5jDDfLvXFexeXtx. The scope below replaces the original `personName` proposal; the original is summarised under "Superseded" and is in this body's edit history. This rewrite changes no label and does not lift the hold.

## Source

- Filed from HotCRM card objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2431 (landed app-side as hotcrm#2433), 2026-11-12.
- 2026-11-13, maintainer ruling on this card: 「32677 暂停，先由元数据项目自己处理」 (comment 6844918971).
- 2026-11-17, the discussion that produced this rewrite (verbatim):
  - 「中国人填表单，你让他填一个姓，一个名，也很奇怪吧」
  - 「hotcrm 需要同时服务国内客户和海外客户」
  - 「姓 必填，把名隐藏，填入姓名，姓名是算出来的，还是没问题啊」
  - 「不一定按语言，可以按照组织的区域设置」

## The business need

- A Chinese user expects one 「姓名」 input. Asking for 姓 and 名 separately is unnatural, in either order. The original card only reordered the two inputs.
- HotCRM serves domestic and overseas customers from one data model, so the two stored fields (given, family) stay.
- The app-side recipe needs no data-model change:
  - the family-name field stays required; in a Chinese organization the user types the whole name into it (「张伟」);
  - the given-name field is hidden and left empty;
  - the computed display name then equals the family-name field.
- The switch is the organization's regional setting, not the viewer's language: everyone in one organization enters names the same way.

## The gap (read at `f02f4f63`)

The recipe is all app metadata except one step: hiding the given-name field by the organization's regional setting.

- A form-view field's `visibleWhen` resolves `record` (+ `previous`, `parent`) and `current_user`, client-side only: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:4141`.
- The client predicate scope carries no organization: `ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useFilterScope.ts:29` (「it carries no organization」).
- The organization's regional setting exists: the Localization setting `localization.locale` (beside `localization.timezone` and `localization.currency`).
- The formula scope has an `os.org` slot (`packages/formula/src/types.ts:154`, `packages/formula/src/stdlib.ts`), but the call sites read so far bind only the organization id. Not every call site was read.

## Scope

1. A form-view predicate (`visibleWhen`, and `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` on the same faces) can read the organization's Localization locale.
2. The spelling, and which root it lives under, is the implementer's proposal for the maintainer to rule. It is a new authorable identifier, so `os validate` must know it and refuse a misspelling.
3. Computed and stored-field expressions are out of scope. The setting is the same for every reader in the organization, so this does not reopen "the `cel` dialect reads no locale" (`packages/formula/src/types.ts:115`), which is about the viewer's locale.
4. The public form route (`/f/:slug`) publishes no scope today, so such a predicate faults open there and both inputs show. State that in the key's description.

## Open points for the ruling

- **Label.** A field label follows the viewer's language, while the hide follows the organization. A user in a Chinese organization with an English interface sees one input labelled "Last name". Accept it, or let a label follow the organization too.
- **A dedicated setting.** Dynamics 365 has an organization-wide "Full name format" option; the OCA `partner_firstname` module for Odoo has a "names order" setting with a recalculate button; Salesforce orders its name inputs by the organization's default locale, with the user's locale overriding. None of them hides the given-name input. A dedicated "name format" option, for an organization in China that wants separate inputs, stays a separate later card, as the original card already had it (the p3 tenant override).

## Superseded (the original proposal, not to be built)

- Object key `personName: { given, family, salutation?, middle? }`.
- Form, quick-create, inline-edit, list and detail order by the user's locale (CLDR `nameOrder`).
- Formula `personName(given, family)`, ordering the display name by the script of the family name.
- The 2026-11-12 analysis (comment 6821675141) recommended a narrowed variant B of it. This rewrite replaces both.

## hotcrm half

Once the predicate can read the setting, HotCRM:
- adds the visibility predicate on the given-name field of `crm_contact` and `crm_lead`;
- labels the family-name field 「姓名」 in zh;
- checks that its display-name function yields the family-name field alone when the given name is empty or blank;
- matches duplicates on the display name, since 「张伟」 entered in one input and 张 + 伟 entered in two differ field by field.
